title: Industry Distress Anomaly
title_zh: 行业困境异象
authors: Hui Chen, Winston Wei Dou, Hongye Guo, Yan Ji
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We document a robust industry-level distress anomaly in which more distressed industries earn significantly lower expected equity returns. The anomaly is distinct from the firm-level distress anomaly (Campbell, Hilscher and Szilagyi, 2008). It remains significant after controlling for firm-level distress but disappears in placebo industries formed by randomly reshuffling firms across actual industries. Both theoretically and empirically, we show that competition-distress feedback amplifies the exposure of industry profit margins and equity returns to discount-rate shocks. Industries with greater idiosyncratic left-tail risk are more distressed but exhibit weaker competition-distress feedback. This effect reduces their exposure to discount-rate shocks and thus lowers their expected equity returns.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了一个稳健的行业层面困境异象，即困境程度更高的行业获得的预期股票收益率显著更低。该异象与公司层面的困境异象（Campbell, Hilscher and Szilagyi, 2008）存在显著差异。在控制公司层面困境后，该异象依然显著，但在通过随机重组实际行业中的公司所形成的虚拟行业中则消失。理论与实证均表明，竞争-困境反馈机制放大了行业利润率与股票收益率对贴现率冲击的暴露程度。具有更大特质性左尾风险的行业困境程度更高，但其竞争-困境反馈效应更弱。这一效应降低了这些行业对贴现率冲击的暴露程度，从而降低了其预期股票收益率。

title: Effects of Lottery Incentives for Influenza Vaccination: Evidence from a Large-Scale Randomized Trial and Causal Forest Analysis
title_zh: 彩票激励对流感疫苗接种的影响：来自大规模随机试验与因果森林分析的证据
authors: Kelsey Moran, Gail M. Rosenbaum, Amir Goren, Michelle N. Meyer, Christopher F. Chabris 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Financial incentives may encourage vaccination, but their cost-effectiveness depends on targeting patients who are most responsive. We conducted a randomized controlled trial with 57,579 adult patients in an integrated health system during the 2021–2022 influenza season. Patients with an upcoming appointment were randomized to a no-contact control, a simple reminder, a $1 cash incentive, or a scratch-off lottery ticket incentive worth up to $5,000. Any active intervention increased vaccination at the scheduled appointment by 2 percentage points (an 8% increase over the control mean) and by 1.5 percentage points over the full influenza season. The three active arms did not differ significantly, indicating that small financial incentives provided no additional benefit beyond a reminder. Using electronic health records and area-level characteristics, we used causal forests to estimate conditional average treatment effects. Predicted responsiveness varied substantially: patients in the top quartile were 3–4 times more likely to respond to incentives than those in the bottom quartile, whereas reminder effects were relatively homogeneous. These findings suggest that low-cost reminders can increase influenza vaccination, while machine-learning methods can help identify patients most responsive to small financial incentives.
abstract_zh: 经济激励可能促进疫苗接种，但其成本效益取决于能否精准锁定最易响应的患者群体。我们在2021-2022年流感季期间，对某整合医疗系统中57,579名成年患者开展随机对照试验。将近期有预约的患者随机分为四组：无接触对照组、简单提醒组、1美元现金激励组、最高价值5000美元的刮刮乐彩票激励组。任何主动干预措施均使预约接种率提升2个百分点（较对照组均值增长8%），整个流感季接种率提升1.5个百分点。三个干预组间无显著差异，表明小额经济激励相较于单纯提醒并未产生额外效益。我们利用电子健康档案与区域特征数据，通过因果森林模型估计条件平均处理效应。预测响应度呈现显著异质性：响应度最高四分位患者对激励措施的反应概率是低四分位患者的3-4倍，而提醒效应的异质性相对较小。研究结果表明，低成本提醒可提升流感疫苗接种率，机器学习方法则有助于识别对小额经济激励最敏感的患者群体。

title: Elite Capture, Meritocracy and Social Stability: Evidence from the Chinese Imperial Examinations
title_zh: 精英俘获、精英统治与社会稳定：来自中国科举制度的证据
authors: Jingjing Chen, Jianlei Han, Shing-Yi Wang, Yongxiang Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines reforms in China’s imperial examination system during the Northern Song dynasty that anonymized exam submissions and ended local officials’ discretion to recommend candidates. Using prefecture-level data from 960–1127 and a difference-in-differences design, we compare areas with and without prominent elite families, where corruption and elite capture were more likely. The reforms increased the share of successful candidates from commoner backgrounds and narrowed their performance gaps with elites in scholarship and political achievement, indicating better selection of commoner talent. Treated prefectures also saw less social unrest. Overall, the reforms strengthened meritocracy, broadened political access, and promoted stability.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了北宋时期科举制度的改革，该改革对考卷进行匿名处理，并终止了地方官员推荐考生的自由裁量权。利用960年至1127年的府级数据，并采用双重差分法，我们比较了存在显著精英家族的地区（这些地区更易发生腐败和精英俘获）与其他地区的情况。改革提高了来自平民背景的考生中举比例，并缩小了他们与精英阶层在学术造诣和政治成就上的表现差距，表明对平民人才的选拔更为有效。受改革影响的府级地区社会动荡也有所减少。总体而言，改革强化了贤能政治，拓宽了政治参与渠道，并促进了社会稳定。

title: Motherhood timing and the child penalty
title_zh: 母亲生育时机与子女惩罚
authors: Anikó Bíró, Steven Dieterle, Andreas Steinhauer
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Age at first birth has increased over time, which is likely to create many benefits in the labour market. Applying a number of alternative estimation approaches to administrative data from Austria, we estimate small to moderate effects of delaying motherhood on earnings, employment, and attachment to pre-birth firms in the medium run. However, even the largest of these effects are small relative to the average age effects, implying that delay leads to only small changes in child penalties. Much of the career return to later first birth comes from delaying the child penalty rather than changing how careers respond to children.
abstract_zh: 初育年龄随时间推移而上升，这很可能在劳动力市场中带来诸多益处。通过运用多种替代性估计方法对奥地利行政数据进行分析，我们发现在中期内，推迟生育对女性收入、就业状况及与产前企业的依附关系仅产生较小至中等程度的影响。然而，即便这些影响中最为显著的效应，相较于平均年龄效应而言仍显微弱，这意味着推迟生育仅能小幅改变育儿惩罚。推迟初育带来的职业回报，主要源于育儿惩罚的延迟而非职业发展对育儿行为反应的改变。

title: The Role of Risk Aversion and Intertemporal Substitution in Dynamic Consumption-Portfolio Choicewith Recursive Utility
title_zh: 风险厌恶与跨期替代在递归效用动态消费-投资组合选择中的作用
authors: Harjoat Singh Bhamra, Raman Uppal, James Heckman, Bridget Galaty, Haihan Tian 等
official: 官方在线 2005-04-23 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this paper is to understand the implications for consumption and portfolio choice of the separation of an investor?s risk aversion and elasticity of intertemporal substitution that is made possible by recursive utility, in contrast to expected utility, where the two are governed by the same parameter. In particular, we study exactly how risk aversion and elasticity of intertemporal substitution affect optimal dynamic consumption and portfolio decisions. For a three-date, discrete-time model with a stochastic interest rate, we obtain an exact analytic solution for the optimal consumption and portfolio policies. We find that, in general, the consumption and portfolio decisions depend on both risk aversion and the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. Only in the case where the investment opportunity set is constant, is the optimal portfolio weight independent of the elasticity of intertemporal substitution. We also find that the size of risk aversion relative to unity determines the sign of the intertemporal hedging component in the optimal portfolio, while elasticity of intertemporal substitution affects only the magnitude of the hedging component.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在理解递归效用（recursive utility）相较于预期效用（expected utility）所实现的投资者风险厌恶（risk aversion）与跨期替代弹性（elasticity of intertemporal substitution）分离对消费与投资组合选择的影响——在预期效用框架下，两者由同一参数决定。具体而言，我们精确研究了风险厌恶与跨期替代弹性如何影响最优动态消费与投资组合决策。针对一个包含随机利率的三期离散时间模型，我们推导出最优消费与投资组合策略的精确解析解。研究发现，一般而言，消费与投资组合决策同时取决于风险厌恶与跨期替代弹性。仅当投资机会集恒定时，最优投资组合权重才独立于跨期替代弹性。此外，风险厌恶相对于1的大小决定了最优投资组合中跨期对冲成分的符号，而跨期替代弹性仅影响该对冲成分的规模。

title:
What Really Drives Agri‐Environment‐Climate Measures' Adoption? Mandatory Requirements, Behavioral Traits, and Structural Factors in the
                    CAP
                    Green Architecture
title_zh: 真正驱动农业-环境-气候措施采纳的因素是什么？CAP绿色架构中的强制性要求、行为特征与结构性因素
authors: L. Sanchez‐Mata, M. Rodríguez‐Entrena, M. Espinosa‐Goded, F. J. Dessart, J. Barreiro‐Hurlé
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: To increase farmer adoption of green practices, the EU Common Agricultural Policy includes both mandatory (conditionality) and voluntary instruments (eco‐schemes–ECS– and more demanding, multi‐annual agri‐environment‐climate measures –AECM–). Building on the experiment of Barreiro‐Hurle et al. (2023), which focused on eco‐schemes, this paper analyses farmers' stated willingness to voluntarily adopt AECM. Using a framed experiment with 600 farmers in Spain, Germany, and Poland, we compared two policy interventions—higher mandatory environmental requirements and an equivalent reduction in income linked to CAP direct payments—and varied their intensity. Higher mandatory environmental requirements and an equivalent income reduction reduce the willingness to voluntarily adopt AECM. We also find a positive conditional association between the intensity of ECS adoption and the willingness to adopt AECM, suggesting potential spillover effects. We further show that behavioral factors, particularly perceived fairness of compensation, environmental concern, confidence in the environmental program, and CAP entitlement, explain substantially more variation in willingness to adopt AECM than standard structural and socio‐demographic characteristics (farm and farmer features). These results have implications for the upcoming envisaged CAP green architecture.
abstract_zh: 摘要 为提升农民对绿色实践的采纳率，欧盟共同农业政策同时包含强制性（条件性）与自愿性工具（生态计划——ECS——以及要求更高、多年期的农业环境气候措施——AECM）。本文基于Barreiro‐Hurle等人（2023）聚焦生态计划的实验研究，进一步分析农民自愿采纳AECM的陈述意愿。通过对西班牙、德国和波兰600名农民开展框架实验，我们比较了两种政策干预——提高强制性环境要求与等额削减CAP直接支付相关的收入——并调整其强度。结果表明，更高的强制性环境要求与等额收入削减均会降低农民自愿采纳AECM的意愿。同时，我们发现ECS采纳强度与AECM采纳意愿之间存在正向条件关联，暗示潜在溢出效应。进一步分析显示，行为因素（尤其是补偿公平感知、环境关切、对环保项目的信心及CAP权益认知）对AECM采纳意愿的解释力显著高于标准的结构性与社会人口特征（农场与农民属性）。这些发现对即将实施的CAP绿色架构具有政策启示。

title: Zoning: Externalities or Misallocation?
title_zh: 分区：外部性还是资源错配？
authors: Yu-Hsin Ho, Chang-Tai Hsieh, Wen-Tai Hsu, Yu-Jhih Luo
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how residential-commercial zoning affects the allocation of urban space. Using property-level data from Taipei and 34 U.S. metropolitan areas, we infer neighborhood-level zoning wedges from the allocation of residents, workers, and floor space. We find substantially greater dispersion in these wedges in U.S. cities than in Taipei, where mixed-use development is pervasive. The inferred wedges increase neighborhood specialization and reduce welfare. We then evaluate whether zoning is aligned with the neighborhood characteristics that would justify intervention. Although zoning is systematically related to comparative advantage, comparative advantage explains only a small fraction of the variation in zoning. The dominant effect of zoning in American cities is therefore not to promote efficient land use, but to increase the segregation of residential and commercial activity across neighborhoods.
abstract_zh: 本文研究住宅-商业分区如何影响城市空间的配置。利用台北及美国34个大都市区的房产层面数据，我们从居民、劳动者及楼面空间的配置中推断出社区层面的分区楔子。研究发现，美国城市中这些楔子的离散程度显著高于混合用途开发普遍存在的台北。推断出的楔子加剧了社区专业化并降低了社会福利。随后，我们评估分区是否与可证明干预合理性的社区特征相一致。尽管分区与比较优势存在系统性关联，但比较优势仅能解释分区变化的极小部分。因此，美国城市中分区的主导作用并非促进土地高效利用，而是加剧了住宅与商业活动在社区间的隔离。

title: Capturing Heterogeneity: Machine Learning Approaches to Implied Volatility Forecasting
title_zh: 捕捉异质性：隐含波动率预测的机器学习方法
authors: Hyung Joo Kim, Dong Hwan Oh
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Despite documented heterogeneity in volatility dynamics across the option surface, standard implied volatility forecasting models apply homogeneous parameters throughout. We introduce a machine-learning framework that uses regression trees to partition the surface along both moneyness and maturity dimensions, identifying data-driven regions where distinct forecasting models perform best. Extending the Surface Heterogeneous Autoregressive (SHAR) framework of Dufays, Jacobs, and Rombouts (2025), we develop tree-based SHAR specifications that preserve interpretable structure while allowing model parameters to vary across the surface. Empirical analysis using S&P 500 options demonstrates that the boosted tree-based specification achieves the lowest out-of-sample forecast errors across all horizons, reducing one-month-ahead RMSE by 13 percent versus the benchmark SHAR model. The improvements are statistically significant and particularly pronounced during stress periods. The estimated tree presents economically interpretable segmentation: short-dated options exhibit higher daily persistence but lower monthly persistence than long-dated options, while deep out-of-the-money calls or puts display distinct dynamics from near-the-money contracts.
abstract_zh: 尽管期权曲面上的波动率动态存在显著异质性，但标准隐含波动率预测模型在整个曲面上均采用同质参数。我们引入一种基于回归树的机器学习框架，沿期限与执行价两个维度对曲面进行划分，识别出不同预测模型表现最优的数据驱动区域。通过扩展Dufays、Jacobs与Rombouts（2025）提出的曲面异质自回归（SHAR）框架，我们开发了基于树的SHAR模型，在保持可解释结构的同时允许模型参数随曲面位置变化。基于标普500期权的实证分析表明，增强型树模型在所有预测期限上均实现最低的样本外预测误差，将一个月前瞻均方根误差较基准SHAR模型降低13%。该改进具有统计显著性，且在压力时期尤为突出。估计树呈现经济可解释的分段特征：短期期权较长期期权具有更高的日度持续性但更低的月度持续性，而深度虚值看涨/看跌期权则展现出与平值期权截然不同的动态特征。

title: An Analytical Model of Behavior and Policy in an Epidemic
title_zh: 流行病中行为与政策的分析模型
authors: Lukasz Rachel
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the behavior of individuals susceptible to a deadly disease in a tractable equilibrium setting. We analytically characterize individually optimal mitigation behavior and the resulting equilibrium trajectory. Analysis is facilitated by a phase diagram. A key insight is that individually optimal behavior of those susceptible to the disease results in excessive caution. This behavior flattens the epidemic curve and prolongs the epidemic. In contrast, socially optimal behavior results in a higher infection rate, with a focus on minimizing cumulative deaths at minimum cost. The paper offers novel technical contributions and an improved understanding of externalities in econ-epi models. (JEL D62, D91, I12, I18)
abstract_zh: 本文在一个易于处理的均衡框架下，研究了易感致命疾病个体的行为。我们通过解析方法刻画了个体最优的缓解行为及其导致的均衡轨迹，并借助相图进行分析。核心发现是：易感个体的最优行为会导致过度谨慎，这种平缓了流行病曲线，却延长了疫情持续时间。相比之下，社会最优行为会带来更高的感染率，其核心目标是以最小成本最小化累计死亡人数。本文在技术层面提出创新，并深化了对经济-流行病模型中外部性的理解。（JEL D62, D91, I12, I18）

title_zh: 顺序效应与教师劳动力供给：厄瓜多尔的一项全国性随机对照试验
authors: Nicolás Ajzenman, Gregory Elacqua, Luana Marotta, Anne Sofie Olsen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We evaluate a nationwide zero-cost intervention to reduce teacher sorting, where lower-income students are more likely to attend understaffed schools with less qualified teachers. Our approach was grounded in an insight from behavioral economics known as order effects. In the treatment arm, the teacher job application platform showed hard-to-staff schools first, while, in the control group, schools were displayed alphabetically. Treated teachers were more likely to apply to hard-to-staff schools, ranking them their highest priority. Inattentive or less qualified teachers did not influence the results. The intervention helped to reduce the unequal distribution of qualified teachers across schools. (JEL D91, I23, I24, J28, J45, O15)
abstract_zh: 我们评估了一项全国性的零成本干预措施，旨在减少教师分配不均问题——低收入家庭学生更可能就读于师资短缺、教师资质较差的学校。该干预措施基于行为经济学中的“顺序效应”洞见。在实验组中，教师求职平台优先展示师资紧缺学校，而对照组则按字母顺序排列学校。受干预的教师更倾向于申请师资紧缺学校，并将其列为最高优先级。注意力不集中或资质较差的教师并未影响结果。该干预措施有助于缩小合格教师在学校间的不均衡分布。（JEL分类号：D91, I23, I24, J28, J45, O15）

title: Bayesian Model Averaging in Causal Instrumental Variable Models
title_zh: 因果工具变量模型中的贝叶斯模型平均
authors: Gregor Steiner, Mark Steel
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Instrumental variables are a popular tool to infer causal effects under unobserved confounding, but choosing suitable instruments is challenging in practice. We propose gIVBMA, a Bayesian model averaging procedure that addresses this challenge by averaging across different sets of instrumental variables and covariates in a structural equation model. This allows for data‐driven selection of valid and relevant instruments and provides additional robustness against invalid instruments. Our approach extends previous work through a scale‐invariant prior structure and accommodates non‐Gaussian outcomes and treatments, offering greater flexibility than existing methods. The computational strategy uses conditional Bayes factors to update models separately for the outcome and treatments. We prove that this model selection procedure is consistent. In simulation experiments, gIVBMA outperforms current state‐of‐the‐art methods. We demonstrate its usefulness in two empirical applications: the effects of malaria and institutions on income per capita and the returns to schooling. A software implementation of gIVBMA is available in Julia.
abstract_zh: 工具变量是在存在未观测混杂因素时推断因果效应的常用方法，但在实践中选择合适的工具变量颇具挑战性。我们提出gIVBMA方法，这是一种通过结构方程模型中对不同工具变量集和协变量集进行平均化的贝叶斯模型平均程序。该方法能够基于数据驱动选择有效且相关的工具变量，并增强对无效工具变量的稳健性。我们的方法通过尺度不变先验结构扩展了先前研究，并兼容非高斯结果变量和处理变量，比现有方法具有更高灵活性。计算策略采用条件贝叶斯因子分别更新结果方程和处理方程的模型。我们证明该模型选择程序具有一致性。模拟实验表明，gIVBMA优于当前最先进方法。我们在两个实证应用中验证其实用价值：疟疾与制度对人均收入的影响，以及教育回报率。gIVBMA的软件实现已发布于Julia平台。
